decision: The parser-v3-v1 locked evaluator set is constructed, blind-labeled, fingerprinted, manifested and ready to seal. Track D hands the set, the labels, the manifests and a complete sealing specification to the main agent. No parser-v3 evaluation was run.
deviations: reviewer span convention (marker-inclusive) differs from the curator's registration convention (bare literal); resolved by comparing span kind, disposition and canonical value rather than character offsets
the curator's registered candidate_answers convention for present cases was corrected mid-run to match the published protocol
one exact overlap and a family of masked-template near-duplicates were found by the gates and fixed by rewriting the affected cases; no gate was waived
manifest and reviewer-row filenames were migrated on main-agent instruction so that the manifests stay committable under the shared .gitignore; no case, label or reviewer row changed
the locked case inputs were deliberately kept private rather than committed, so that parser-v3 development in this same worktree cannot be tuned to the holdout
next_gate: Main agent: run the three cross-checks in docs/phase1_parser_v3_sealing_run.md section 9 against the published per-record fingerprints; if all intersections are empty, seal to phase1-evaluator-validation/parser-v3-v1/<timestamp> with the set manifest written last; only then schedule a parser-v3 locked evaluation.
prohibited_interpretations: NO PARSER-V3 EVALUATION WAS RUN IN THIS ROUND AND NO PARSER-V3 RESULT EXISTS.
Do not read any number in this artifact pack as a parser-v3 accuracy, precision, recall or error rate.
Do not compare anything here against parser-v2 locked-evaluation results.
Do not treat the labels as human ground truth; they are a two-reviewer-plus-arbiter LLM consensus.
Do not treat zero overlap as unconditional; it is proven only against reachable corpora.
Do not describe the isolation as a security or RBAC boundary; it is procedural and hash-audited.
Do not treat this set as sealed or pre-registered until the main agent completes the sealing run.
Do not infer any headroom, calibration or J-lens claim from this pack.
scientific_interpretation: Track D produced an instrument, not a measurement. Two independent reference-blind LLM reviewers reached whole-row exact agreement on 113/120 cases, and an arbiter resolved the remaining 7 without ever seeing an agreeing row. The resulting labels are an LLM operational consensus reference. Zero overlap is demonstrated against every corpus Track D could read and is asserted-pending-verification against the two it could not. Isolation from parser-v3 development is procedural and hash-audited, not security-enforced. The instrument becomes a genuine pre-registered holdout only once the main agent seals it.
